name: hdie_host_phy_r1-r2-COMMIT
purpose: host_phy r2 (HBM-NATIVE 10-17): feedthrough pin flops split into an input-pin capture flop + an output-pin launch flop on TX/RX/session (+1 edge each, elastic link); native audit phy_tx launch 255.2 > 220

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_host_phy_adapt u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/host_static_20261015/ot_hbm_host_phy_adapt.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hdie_host_phy_r1/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hdie_host_phy_r1/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hdie_host_phy_r1 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_host_phy_adapt  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: host_phy r2 (HBM-NATIVE 10-17): every face-to-face feedthrough (ep_tx S -> phy_tx N, phy_rx W -> ep_rx E, session_pad S -> session E) is two flops, capture at the input pin and launch at the output pin (io_flop_at_pins anchors each at its own face); +1 edge TX/RX/session vs r1, elastic host link (endpoint CRC/replay/credits) so no compile-schedule change; pad/status checks unchanged. Lockstep tb_host_phy_pin_stage vs the closed dcfed59ab RTL (data +1 edge, faults same edge), mutant rejected.

reroute_reason.why: routed native pin audit (NATIVE-BATCH 10-17): phy_tx launch up to 255.2 > 220 ps on 12 pins: phy_tx <= ep_tx was ONE feedthrough flop between the S (ep_tx) and N (phy_tx) faces, so it sat at its ep_tx pin (phy_tx[460] flop at y 3.2, 87+45 um from its N pin); TX, RX and session are now capture flop at the input pin + launch flop at the output pin (+1 edge each, elastic link)
